description: This file defines interfaces, classes, and providers related to creating and managing grain contexts within the Orleans runtime. It includes implementations for grain context activation, configuration, and shared components, along with detailed mechanisms for interleaving predicates and related configurations.

classes.name: GrainContextActivator
classes.description: A class responsible for creating grain contexts dynamically based on grain types and address, utilizing providers and configurators.

classes.name: GrainTypeSharedContextResolver
classes.description: Resolves and manages shared components for grain types, enabling configuration of common aspects across grains of a specific type.

classes.name: ReentrantSharedComponentsConfigurator
classes.description: Configures shared components for reentrant grain types, especially regarding interleaving capabilities.

classes.name: MayInterleaveConfiguratorProvider
classes.description: Provides configurators for interleaving (MayInterleave) predicates based on grain class attributes.

classes.name: GrainCanInterleave
classes.description: Holds interleaving predicates for a grain context and evaluates whether a message can interleave based on predicates.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new grain context for the specified grain address.

methods.name: CreateActivator
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an activator for a specific grain type, with thread-safety ensured via locking.

methods.name: GetComponents
methods.description: Retrieves or creates shared components for a specific grain type.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures shared components for a grain type, especially regarding reentrancy or interleaving predicates.

methods.name: TryGetConfigurator
methods.description: Attempts to obtain a configurator for a grain type to determine if interleaving is allowed.

methods.name: GetMayInterleavePredicate
methods.description: Determines the predicate used to decide whether a grain class may interleave, based on attributes.
